description:
Currently, rolling back a desktop release requires manually calling LPBS `set-current` with a prior artifact ID — a multi-step process that requires knowing the artifact ID and having admin credentials. Add `POST /api/v1/rollback` to deployment-manager that: (1) looks up the prior artifact for the specified app/platform/channel via LPBS, (2) calls LPBS to promote it, (3) records the rollback event in the deployments table.

Source: research/desktop-release-control-plane-audit conclusion — Finding 9 gap #3.
name: desktop-rollback-api
title: Add rollback API for desktop releases
